snapshot.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
snapshot.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments. [1]

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management anticipated dramatic second-half volume increases exceeding 50-60% over the first half.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: H1 FY26 total sales were 1579.0 INR crore while H2 FY26 sales were 2047.0 INR crore, representing a sequential increase of ~29.6%, falling short of the aggressive 50-60% guidance range.

promises.credibility: Management routinely points to long-term macro goals like a $1 billion revenue target by FY28, but near-term delivery on specific volume acceleration promises has fallen short.

bull: Latest quarter Jun 2026 revenue grew 41% YoY, demonstrating strong top-line momentum across operations.
Profit outgrew revenue over 3 years, with a PAT CAGR of 56% compared to 48% for revenue.
Operating margins are expanding, showing an OPM of 16% versus the 13% average of prior years.
bear: Growth is slowing as the 5-year revenue CAGR of 54% decelerated to 48% over 3 years.
Working capital is stretching significantly, with the cash conversion cycle worsening from 123 to 193 days.
Free cash flow is severely negative at ₹-3,288 Cr, remaining negative in 5 of 5 years.
